title: São Paulo · Serra do Mar and Ubatuba Coast
slogan: A 467 km loop out of Mogi das Cruzes fuel
story: Rainforest descent, ocean heat and a coastal reward. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 186 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Serra do Mar road, Ubatuba coast, Paraty old town, while Mogi das Cruzes fuel and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Paraty old town → Ubatuba coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 66 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
